title: Introduction to Linux
learning_outcomes: Build a correct mental model of Linux as a kernel and an operating-system ecosystem, including the roles of distributions and userspace.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.

overview_visual.caption: Module roadmap for Introduction to Linux; follow the lesson order, then practise and verify in a safe lab.
